title: Postoperative dysbiosis and microbiome regeneration in colorectal cancer surgery using oral antibiotic bowel preparation
summary: Observational study including patients undergoing surgery for colon cancer with perioperative ERAS treatment and recording of microfilm and quality of life.

interventions.name: Standard treatment according to  "enhanced recovery after surgery" principles with use of a oral antibiotic bowel decontamination

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Colon cancer prior to planned surgery
Ability to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
Incapacity to consent
